item.title: Utah girl missing for 17 months found at home of Oregon man who faces federal charge
item.description: A 17-year-old girl from Utah who went missing in May 2025 was found at the home of an Oregon man. Authorites say 39-year-old Adam Hunter Harmel has been charged with transporting the girl across state lines with the intent to engage in criminal sexual activity.

item.title: 2 Colorado college students died when their climbing anchor failed and they fell a long distance
item.description: Authorities say the two Colorado college students whose bodies were recovered last week died when an anchor they were using to climb failed and they fell a “substantial distance."

item.title: Democrat Debbie Wasserman Schultz wins reelection to U.S. House in Florida’s 20th District
item.description: Democrat Debbie Wasserman Schultz won election to the U.S. House of Representatives representing Florida’s 20th Congressional District, defeating Republican Brent Andersen.

item.title: Activist charged with setting fire to embattled Mississippi police department
item.description: An Alabama man has been charged with setting fire to a Mississippi police department that has faced protests in the months since an officer fatally shot a 1-year-old boy.
